handoff: An open story PR now takes the issue's title at the next remote sync: decide emits retitle_pr (a tail side action, so it rides along with the mirror on the sync tick) when an open PR's title differs from the issue's; RemotePort gains editPullRequestTitle and PR titles (gh, glab, FakeRemote, contract suite). Harness regression test: issue renamed after open-pr → PR retitled once at the next sync. The release ready gate drops its title check. Not run against real gh/glab; a hand-renamed PR is renamed back to the issue's title.
